description: NASA Heroes is a creative and ambitious team passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. We enjoy turning challenging problems into exciting and practical ideas. Our team combines creativity, teamwork, research, and problem-solving skills. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, our goal is to create an innovative, interactive, and meaningful solution that makes learning about space fun and inspiring. 🚀🌙
summary: Al Azm Emirati Space Heroes presents an interactive educational game that introduces young learners to space mission challenges. Players manage a space base and make decisions about power, food, and life support. Through these choices, they learn how limited resources and engineering trade-offs affect mission success. Our project makes space learning simple and enjoyable while encouraging problem-solving and an interest in science and engineering.
details:
Our project addresses the “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer” challenge through an interactive educational game. Players take the role of a mission planner and manage essential resources for a space base, including power, food, and life support.

Players must balance competing needs and consider how their decisions affect the mission. This introduces engineering trade-offs through learning by doing. The project aims to make space science easier to understand and encourage critical thinking, planning, and problem-solving.

ChatGPT was used to assist with drafting and organizing the project description. The game is an educational simulation, rather than a tool for planning real space missions.
